summary.text: Molly McCoy St. Jeanne is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 29, in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the September 8, 2026 Democratic primary.
She currently serves as an at-large member of the Hampton School District, with a term ending in 2027.
